name: no_args
stdout:
mode:         0
-o  offset:       <MATCH> us
-f  freq.adjust:  <MATCH> (65536 = 1ppm)
    maxerror:     <MATCH>
    esterror:     <MATCH>
    status:       <MATCH> (PLL)
-p  timeconstant: 7
    precision:    1 us
    tolerance:    32768000
-t  tick:         10000 us
    time.tv_sec:  <MATCH>
    time.tv_usec: <MATCH>
    return value: 0 (clock synchronized)
